skill.displayName: 商誉减值测试底稿核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: This skill is a local goodwill impairment worksheet checker whose file reads and Bash use match its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill requests Read and Bash and reads a user-specified input file, which is proportionate for a local worksheet checker but may involve sensitive financial data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer, dependency download, package install, or remote payload retrieval was found; the CLI uses Node standard library and a bundled engine file.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are limited to running the bundled Node script on a sample or a user-provided worksheet file; there are no prompt overrides, hidden role changes, or unrelated agent instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The inspected code does not write files, read environment variables, access credentials, make network calls, create persistence, or modify system state.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact consistently describes deterministic checks for goodwill impairment test worksheets, and the bundled code implements formula, total-row, duplicate, blank, and missing-column checks.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, users should understand that the tool may process sensitive financial worksheet content, but the inspected artifact keeps processing local and does not send data over the network. It is a formula and consistency checker, not accounting, tax, valuation, audit, or assurance advice.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The flagged SKILL.md lines are normal usage examples referencing scripts/run.mjs; the referenced script exists and was inspected, so this is not evidence of analysis evasion.
[SDI-4] unexpected: One comment in scripts/run.mjs mentions pasted contract text, but surrounding help text and executable behavior consistently process goodwill impairment worksheet text; this is a documentation typo, not a security concern.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The supplied SARIF contained no security findings, which is consistent with the inspected local-only implementation.
